newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moody's upgrades West Australia and Victoria.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moody's upgrades West Australia and Victoria.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Monday that it upgraded the rating of domestic currency-denominated bonds of the Australian states of Victoria and Western Australia.
The ratings agency said the rating of Victoria had been raised to AA1 from AA2.
The ratiang of Western Australia had been increased to AAA from AA1.
Moody's said the ratings of guaranteed bonds issued by Treasury Corp of Victoria had also been upgraded to AA1 as a result of the action.
It said the upgrading of Victoria reflects the sharp improvement in the state's debt profile as well as continued favourable developments in its budget position.
